selectionRationale: Reuse the existing canonical shared ProfileAvatar and its authenticated viewer-scoped server rank lookup; avoid screen-specific duplicated badge code, new server reward rules, and 40 separate runtime image decodes. Keep the original approved artwork with per-cell alpha.
alternativeApproaches: 40 independent require() image files in every row: rejected for high decoding/memory overhead and unnecessary app size
Render the old SVG shield or a generic square badge: rejected because it violates the owner's approved original transparent design
Make a new rank/presence authority independent of the existing rank RPC: rejected because it risks divergent rankings and Season 1 production data
